CANONICAL_NAME.value: COBOL Programming Course (Open Mainframe Project / IBM, 2020-): CBL0001..CBL0014, PAYROL00 -- real mainframe COBOL with EBCDIC packed-decimal data, run under GnuCOBOL 3

VERSION.value: github.com/openmainframeproject/cobol-programming-course master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes); Course #2 Labs/cbl + Labs/data

value.lineage: The business-computing culture as it still runs: fixed-format COBOL (IDENTIFICATION/ENVIRONMENT/DATA/PROCEDURE divisions, PICTURE clauses, COMP-3 packed decimal, FD/SELECT/ASSIGN to JCL DDNAMEs), reading a 170-byte fixed-record EBCDIC account file and writing a formatted report. Written for z/OS; here compiled by GnuCOBOL 3.1.2 with DDNAME-to-file mapping through the environment. Chosen after the NIST COBOL-85 validation suite (newcob.val) proved UNAVAILABLE at its origin (see the batch report: ORIGIN_UNAVAILABLE).

value.built_to: process fixed-format business records -- accounts, balances, limits, payroll -- in batch and print formatted reports, exactly as mainframe shops have since the 1960s
value.pressure: decades-old data formats (EBCDIC, packed decimal) that must keep working; auditability of money arithmetic (decimal, not float)
value.success_means: every record read, every amount formatted exactly (PICTURE editing), totals correct to the cent

value.pressure: format longevity, exact decimal arithmetic, regulatory auditability
value.failure_condition: a truncated or mis-edited amount in a financial report

value: COBOL (IBM Enterprise COBOL dialect, fixed format)
